summary: Public projects created on 3 November 2026: 4 repos, 2 datasets and 2 models.
intro: New repositories covered agent tooling and home network security, with three agent plugins and a playbook for keeping cheap IP cameras local-only. On Hugging Face, the new work was speech-recognition training material: a small model that writes read-aloud sentences, its training data, and a mixed English-Hebrew sentence dataset.

projects.name: ChatGPT Workspace Agents Claude Plugin
projects.description: Builds and manages ChatGPT Workspace Agents from Claude Code by driving the agent builder in a browser, since OpenAI has no public API for creating them.

projects.name: Guava Health Plugin
projects.description: Unofficial plugin and Python CLI for the Guava Health API: logs medications, symptoms and readings, and reviews the data, including for dependents on a family plan.

projects.name: IP Cam Lockdown
projects.description: Forensics and a playbook for running cheap AliExpress IP cameras local-only: how each one reaches the vendor cloud, and how to cut it off.

projects.name: Network Forensics Plugin
projects.description: Skills for tracing what a device on a home network talks to, documenting it, blocking it at the firewall and verifying the lockdown.

projects.name: English Hebrew Mixed Sentences
projects.description: English sentences with Hebrew words and phrases mixed in, for training and evaluating speech-to-text for English speakers in Israel.

projects.name: Term Context Sentences
projects.description: Training data for writing short read-aloud sentences that use a given term in a given context, covering romanized Hebrew and Yiddish, Israeli names and tech vocabulary.

projects.name: Contextual Sentence Creator
projects.description: LoRA fine-tune of Granite 4.2 3B that returns natural sentences using a given term in a given context, for recording speech-recognition training data.

projects.name: Contextual Sentence Creator GGUF
projects.description: GGUF builds of Contextual-Sentence-Creator in Q4_K_M and Q8_0, for running it with llama.cpp.
